function.name: weather_forecast_get_prediction
function.description: Fetches the weather prediction for a specified location and date range, including temperature, precipitation chances, and wind speed. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The geographical location for which the weather forecast is requested, in the format of 'City, State' or 'City, Country', such as 'Berkeley, CA' or 'London, UK'.

start_date.description: The start date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

end_date.description: The end date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

units.description: The unit system used for the weather forecast results.

include_details.description: A flag indicating whether to include detailed forecast information such as hourly data.

Here’s a quick guide to the most popular men’s underwear styles—what they’re good for, their pros & cons, and a few brand picks that consistently get high marks. | Style | What it looks like | Best for | Pros | Cons | Brand Picks | |-------|--------------------|----------|------|------|-------------| | **Briefs** (classic “tight” cut) | High‑waisted, snug around hips and thighs, no leg coverage | Everyday wear, athletic activities, hot climates | • Excellent support
• Minimal bulk under clothing
• Great for tight‑fitting pants | • Can feel restrictive if too tight
• Less breathable if made from synthetic fabrics | Calvin Klein, Tommy Hilfiger, Hanes ComfortSoft | | **Boxer Briefs** (mid‑cut, longer than briefs) | Combines brief support with longer leg coverage | Versatile for work, travel, sports, casual wear | • Good support + coverage
• Reduces friction on thighs
• Works well under both jeans & sweatpants | • Can bunch up in tight pants
• May feel bulky in very tight trousers | Jockey, Fruit of the Loom, Under Armour Tech | | **Trunks** (shorter leg than boxer briefs) | Similar to boxer briefs but shorter legs | Fashion‑forward look, summer, swimwear | • Sleek silhouette
• Less bulk
• Great for low‑rise shorts | • Not ideal for heavy activity
• Limited leg coverage | Calvin Klein, Polo Ralph Lauren, Lululemon Align | | **Boxers** (loose, full‑length) | Loose fit, long leg, typically elastic waistband | Casual lounging, sleepwear, light outdoor use | • Breathable, airy
• Comfortable for hot nights
• Easy to layer | • Poor support
• Can ride up or bunch in tight pants | Hanes, Fruit of the Loom, Mack Weldon | | **Compression Briefs** (tight, supportive) | Very snug, often with built‑in compression panels | Post‑workout recovery, long flights, medical support | • Muscle support
• Reduced muscle vibration
• Helps circulation | • Can feel restrictive
• Requires proper sizing | Nike Pro, Under Armour HeatGear, 2XU | | **Performance/Tech Fabric** (any cut) | Made from moisture‑wicking, anti‑odor fibers | Athletes, hot climates, travel | • Keeps you dry
• Anti‑odor properties
• Lightweight | • Higher price point
• May not have classic cotton feel | Under Armour Tech, Adidas ClimaCool, Lululemon Align | | **Eco‑Friendly / Sustainable** (organic cotton, bamboo, recycled polyester) | Same cuts, but eco‑friendly materials | Conscious consumers, sensitive skin | • Organic cotton is soft & hypoallergenic
• Bamboo is naturally antibacterial
• Recycled polyester reduces waste | • Can be pricier
• Some eco lines may lack moisture‑wicking | Pact, Alternative Apparel, Patagonia | | **Luxury / Premium** (silk, cashmere blends, high‑thread‑count cotton) | Same cuts, but premium fabrics | Special occasions, gifting, luxury wardrobe | • Ultra‑soft feel
• Often machine washable
• Long‑lasting | • Expensive
• Requires careful care | Tom Ford, Ralph Lauren Purple Label, Brooks Brothers | ### How to Pick the Right Style 1. **Consider your daily activities** - *Athletics*: Compression briefs or performance boxer briefs. - *Office/Business*: Classic briefs or boxer briefs for a clean look. - *Travel*: Compression briefs or performance boxer briefs to reduce chafing. - *Relaxation*: Boxers or luxury cotton for maximum comfort. 2. **Fit matters more than style** - Look for a waistband that stays flat without digging into the waist. - Check the leg length: too short can cause bunching; too long can create excess fabric. 3. **Fabric choice** - Cotton is breathable but can retain moisture. - Synthetic blends wick moisture and dry faster. - Natural fibers like bamboo or organic cotton are great for sensitive skin. 4. **Try before you buy** - If possible, test a pair in-store or order from a retailer with a generous return policy. - Pay attention to how the underwear feels after a few hours of wear. 5. **Maintenance** - Wash according to the label: most performance fabrics do best in cold water. - Avoid fabric softeners—they can clog pores in performance fabrics. ### Quick Brand Highlights | Brand | Known For | Price Range | Where to Buy | |-------|-----------|-------------|--------------| | **Calvin Klein** | Iconic briefs & trunks | $30–$70 | Department stores, online | | **Under Armour** | Performance tech | $25–$60 | Sports retailers, online | | **Pact** | Certified organic cotton | $20–$40 | Online, eco‑stores | | **Brooks Brothers** | Luxury cotton | $50–$120 | Department stores, online | | **Lululemon Align** | Ultra‑soft, stretchy | $80–$100 | Lululemon stores, online | --- #### Bottom line - **For everyday comfort & support**: Boxer briefs or briefs in a breathable cotton blend. - **For active or travel**: Performance boxer briefs or compression briefs. - **For a relaxed, luxurious feel**: Luxury cotton or bamboo boxers/trunks. Mix and match based on your lifestyle—having a small rotation of each type will keep your wardrobe versatile and comfortable. Happy shopping!
